ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels (approx. 90%) to low-intensity black pixels (approx. 10%) localized at the periphery and notch.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white cluster across entire ventral surface. Low-intensity black clusters at the distal tips and a dense, roughly circular black cluster at the median notch. Minor dark pixel cluster (approx. 5x10 pixels) located centrally above the peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture angle of 50 degrees; notch apex depth is approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with high-frequency peaks (amplitude 1-3 pixels) across both lobes; more pronounced indentation on the right lobe proximal to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips; trailing edge maintains a generally linear to slightly curved path until reaching the upturned tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of isolated low-intensity pixel clusters (points) along the trailing edges and a single prominent dark vertical oval spot (approx. 8-12 pixels long) in the mid-lower central region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Single prominent dark vertical oval mark/lesion on the central-lower ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic black 'mask' or cluster of pigmentation localized specifically around the median notch area, extending into the lobes.
